title: Add benchmark lab performance suites & reporting pipeline v123
author: Sofia Patel
description: Context: Add the v123 benchmark lab pipeline which consolidates new performance test suites, updated profiling baselines, representative workload runners, and a reporting DAG. Motivation: unify recent ad-hoc runners into a single, reproducible CI-friendly pipeline, improve baseline stability for kernel-selection profiling, and surface per-model/per-hardware telemetry in the reporting UI. This PR introduces: 1) performance test suites for conversational, embedding, and multi-turn summarization workloads (yaml + runner code); 2) profiling baselines (cpu/gpu memory traces, kernel timings) for kernel-selection experiments; 3) representative workload runners packaged as dockerized tasks (small, medium, large traces); 4) Airflow DAG that runs nightly and publishes aggregated results to telemetry-service/reporting; 5) tests and documentation updates. Checklist: - [x] Add new test-suite definitions and runner harness - [x] Add profiling baseline artifacts and uploaders - [x] Implement reporting DAG with per-model aggregation and retention controls - [x] Add unit and integration tests for runners - [x] Update README and benchmark lab quickstart Notes: kept diffs small by moving helper functions into benchmark_lab/common.py; retained previous v122 artifacts for backwards compatibility. See linked Linear tickets for rollout plan and gating.
